sn22.39:1.3: yaṃ rūpe nibbidā-bahulaṃ vihareyya || vedanāya nibbidā-bahulaṃ vihareyya || saññāya nibbidā-bahulaṃ vihareyya || saṅkhāresu nibbidā-bahulaṃ vihareyya || viññāṇe nibbidā-bahulaṃ vihareyya || || 4
sn22.39:1.4: So rūpe nibbidā-bahulaṃ viharanto || vedanāya || saññāya || saṅkhāresu nibbidā-bahulaṃ viharanto || viññāṇe nibbidā-bahulaṃ viharanto rūpam parijānāti || vedanaṃ || saññaṃ || saṅkhāre || viññāṇam parijānāti || || 5
sn22.39:1.5: So rūpam parijānaṃ || vedanaṃ || saññaṃ || saṅkhāre || viññāṇaṃ parijānaṃ parimuccati rūpamhā || parimuccati vedanāya || pari- saññāya || pari- saṅkharehi || pari- viññāṇamhā ||
sn22.39:1.6: pari- jātiyā jarāmaṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi || parimuccati dukkhasmā ti vadāmīti || || 1-2
